intervals.label: collaboration (project initiated 2007)
intervals.note: Start is the date the project was initiated; the collaboration's formal founding date is not published. Open: the latest collaboration paper read is arXiv:2607.23527 (July 2026).
intervals.quote: The MIMAC experiment is a directional detection project initiated in 2007 at the Laboratoire de Physique Subatomique et de Cosmologie (LPSC Grenoble-France) [22] in collaboration with IRFU-Saclay, CPPM- Marseille, IRSN and recently the Tsinghua University.

name: MIMAC Collaboration
notes: Roster not published in the sources read; the LPSC page (undated, probably old: it cites 2009) says 'a French collaboration of about twenty people'.

summary.plain: The French team, led from the LPSC laboratory in Grenoble, that develops and runs the MIMAC directional dark matter detector in the Modane underground laboratory.
summary.technical: MIMAC (MIcro-tpc MAtrix of Chambers) collaboration: project initiated in 2007 at LPSC Grenoble with IRFU-Saclay, CPPM-Marseille, IRSN and, later, Tsinghua University (arXiv:1504.05865); CPPM Marseille is an author affiliation of arXiv:2607.23527. The LPSC page describes a French collaboration of about twenty people.
